Asset.description: One output file entry: role-keyed href plus integrity metadata.

href.description: Path to the file, e.g. dem.tif, cl.geojson, or a full s3:// URI.
href.title: Href

checksum.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 (64-bit). File-integrity checksums; longer than identity hashes to allow cross-corpus content comparison.
checksum.title: Checksum

source_url.description: External provenance URL (DEM/land-cover endpoint, or db_uri). null for purely computed assets.
source_url.title: Source Url

retrieved.description: When the source was fetched, if applicable.
retrieved.title: Retrieved

derived.description: True for outputs regenerable from sources (terrain, roughness); subject to S3 lifecycle deletion.
derived.title: Derived

Asset.title: Asset

wse_0.description: WSE at the upstream endpoint cell
wse_0.title: Wse 0

wse_1.description: WSE at the downstream endpoint cell
wse_1.title: Wse 1

wse_range.description: wse_0 - wse_1; the width of the valid WSE window
wse_range.title: Wse Range

n_wetted_edge_cells.description: Number of edge cells with any water (non-nan WSE)
n_wetted_edge_cells.title: N Wetted Edge Cells

n_violating_edge_cells.description: Number of edge cells whose WSE falls within [wse_1, wse_0]
n_violating_edge_cells.title: N Violating Edge Cells

n_violating_top.description: Violating cells on the top edge (row 0)
n_violating_top.title: N Violating Top

n_violating_bottom.description: Violating cells on the bottom edge (last row)
n_violating_bottom.title: N Violating Bottom

n_violating_left.description: Violating cells on the left edge (col 0, interior rows)
n_violating_left.title: N Violating Left

n_violating_right.description: Violating cells on the right edge (last col, interior rows)
n_violating_right.title: N Violating Right

worst_violating_wse.description: WSE of the edge cell furthest from wse_0 within the violation window; nan if no violations
worst_violating_wse.title: Worst Violating Wse

closest_edge_margin.description: Minimum distance of any wetted non-violating edge cell WSE to the nearest range boundary; nan if all wetted edge cells are violating
closest_edge_margin.title: Closest Edge Margin

error.description: Error message if a boundary violation was detected, else None
error.title: Error

volume_convergence.description: Ratio of net volume change to total inflow volume over the last mass interval; lower is more converged.
volume_convergence.title: Volume Convergence

boundary_check.description: Edge-boundary violation diagnostics; None if the check was not performed.

model_running.description: True if the solver was still running at this print interval; False if it had already terminated.
model_running.title: Model Running

bbox.description: Domain bbox in native CRS [west, south, east, north].
bbox.title: Bbox

anchor.description: Grid-snapped reach centroid in native CRS [x, y]; origin the offsets are measured from.
anchor.title: Anchor

offsets.description: [N, S, E, W] grid-snapped offsets in CRS units; matches domain_token.
offsets.title: Offsets

GridProperties.description: Grid dimensions of the model domain.

rows.description: Number of rows in the model domain
rows.title: Rows

cols.description: Number of columns in the model domain
cols.title: Cols

GridProperties.title: GridProperties

RunConfig.description: Solver execution settings; constructed once per job and passed to every worker.
RunConfig.title: RunConfig

sdr_commit_id.description: Git commit SHA of the SDR used to run the model
sdr_commit_id.title: Sdr Commit Id

depth.description: Depth grid at the final timestep

inundation_polygon.description: Inundated area polygon at the final timestep

zarr_store.description: Zarr store with depths at each print interval

nominal_wse.description: Nominal water surface elevation measured along the reach's u/s stage transfer line
nominal_wse.title: Nominal Wse

scenario_diagnostics.description: Diagnostics for each model print interval
scenario_diagnostics.title: Scenario Diagnostics

termination_condition.description: How the scenario run was terminated

sim_duration_seconds.description: Simulated time elapsed at termination, in seconds
sim_duration_seconds.title: Sim Duration Seconds

runtime_seconds.description: Wall-clock time for the scenario run, in seconds
runtime_seconds.title: Runtime Seconds

ds_slope.description: Normal-depth slope for the downstream boundary condition
ds_slope.title: Ds Slope

ds_wse.description: Nominal water surface elevation along the downstream stage trnasfer line
ds_wse.title: Ds Wse

scenario_dir_name.description: Output directory name for this scenario's assets
scenario_dir_name.title: Scenario Dir Name

volume_convergence_tolerance.description: Volume convergence threshold; None disables the check
volume_convergence_tolerance.title: Volume Convergence Tolerance

allow_water_on_edges.description: Whether to ignore or terminate when water pools on an invalid edge
allow_water_on_edges.title: Allow Water On Edges

outflow_area_polygon_path.description: Path to polygon marking where the normal-depth boundary condition is applied
outflow_area_polygon_path.title: Outflow Area Polygon Path

model_manifest_path.description: Path to model manifest for the build_model job for this reach
model_manifest_path.title: Model Manifest Path

inflow_line_path.description: Path to lineString defining the upstream inflow boundary
inflow_line_path.title: Inflow Line Path

centerline_path.description: Path to the reach centerline used to determine WSE sample points for domain expansion criteria
centerline_path.title: Centerline Path

domain.description: Domain configuration for the hydraulic model

grid.description: Grid properties for the hydraulic model

model_results_base_path.description: Base directory to which identity hash and scenario point are appended to make the out directory
model_results_base_path.title: Model Results Base Path

out_dir.description: Directory where solver output files are written
out_dir.title: Out Dir

hash_algo.description: Hash function for every hash/checksum in this document. Truncation length is per-field (see build_model-design.md).
hash_algo.title: Hash Algo

created_at.description: Run completion time (UTC). model.json is written last.
created_at.title: Created At

reach_id.description: Primary key for the reach in the reach db
reach_id.title: Reach Id

identity_hash.description: Hash of the identity object. Stable across domain changes; results group under it.
identity_hash.title: Identity Hash

scenario_code.description: Scenario identifier: bc_type + bc_value (integer, optional 1 decimal digit) + 'Q' + integer discharge
scenario_code.title: Scenario Code

identity.description: Canonical identity of the solver environment used for this run.

inputs.description: Inputs used to run the model

assets.description: One entry per output (model.json excluded), keyed by role; hrefs are the flat files under <id>/.

warnings.description: Non-fatal check results; the scenario run still completes and writes scenario.json.
warnings.title: Warnings
